# Arthaleads

> Arthaleads is real estate CRM software for sales teams in India: builders, developers, channel partners and brokers. It brings every property enquiry (Facebook and Instagram lead ads, WhatsApp, website forms, Google Ads, portal sheets) into one place, assigns it to the right person, reminds them to follow up, answers buyers on WhatsApp with an AI agent, and tracks each lead from first call to site visit and booking.

Key facts:

- Founded in 2025 in Pune, Maharashtra, India. Arthaleads is a product of Vistrow Technologies (https://www.vistrow.com).
- Pricing: Starter ₹599 and Growth ₹999 per user per month, plus 18% GST, with a five-seat minimum. Annual billing gives two months free. Enterprise is custom-quoted for large or multi-branch teams. No setup fee.
- 14-day free trial of the Growth plan, no credit card needed. 7-day money-back guarantee on new subscriptions.
- Lead sources: Facebook and Instagram lead ads (automatic), WhatsApp chats, website forms through the WordPress plugin or REST API, Google Ads (Enterprise), and 99acres, MagicBricks and Housing.com leads imported from CSV or Excel.
- WhatsApp AI agent (Growth and Enterprise) replies to buyers day and night in English, Hinglish, Hindi and Marathi; the team can take over any chat.
- Runs on the web and as an Android app for agents.
- Contact: contact@arthaleads.com, +91 90670 97779 (also on WhatsApp).

## Product

- [Home](https://www.arthaleads.com/): What Arthaleads does, who it is for, and answers to common questions
- [Features](https://www.arthaleads.com/features): Every feature, in the order a sales team uses it
- [WhatsApp CRM](https://www.arthaleads.com/whatsapp-crm): WhatsApp inbox, AI agent, templates and campaigns for real estate teams
- [AI CRM for real estate](https://www.arthaleads.com/ai-crm): What the AI does (WhatsApp AI agent, AI lead scoring with reasons, Artha the AI copilot, AI-written follow-ups, call transcripts) and which plan each feature is on
- [Builder CRM](https://www.arthaleads.com/builder-crm): Project-wise lead management for real estate developers: Facebook and WhatsApp capture (Google lead forms on Enterprise), portal imports, site QR codes, telecaller routing, site visits
- [Pricing](https://www.arthaleads.com/pricing): Starter, Growth and Enterprise plans, cost calculator and pricing FAQ
- [Product tour](https://www.arthaleads.com/product-tour): 2-minute film of the product with chapters and transcript
- [Android app](https://www.arthaleads.com/download-app): The app for agents and how to install it
- [WordPress plugin](https://www.arthaleads.com/wordpress-plugin): Sends website form submissions straight into the CRM
- [API docs](https://www.arthaleads.com/api-docs): REST API for connecting other tools
